items.title: Councillor R. Deutschmann Notice of Motion
notes:
R. Deutschmann spoke to his motion, highlighting that under the Community Safety and Policing Act, Council is entitled, under Section 50(4), to establish the policing budget. He noted that taxpayers are clearly calling for financial relief, and Council must explore solutions across all areas, including policing.

Members of the Committee discussed the motion, some explaining their positions and reasoning for their votes.

In response to a question, Wayne Steffler, Commissioner of Corporate Services and CFO, clarified that a 1% increase in the Regional budget equates to $5.3 million.

P. Wolf proposed an amendment to remove numerical figures from the main motion. The amendment was defeated.

N. Salonen clarified that she inadvertently pressed the wrong button when voting. Her vote was corrected in the minutes to reflect her intended position.
